S33.26.needs: a signed-in AGI Cloud account with at least one artifact, and a folder open in VS Code
S33.26.note: No whole-app source download exists in the code (searched 'download source', 'downloadSource', 'source archive', 'zip' in apps/extension-vscode/src and package.json); plan's package.json:593 no longer holds it. The closest feature saves one artifact file into the workspace (registered at apps/extension-vscode/src/core/commandSetup.ts:2650), not the app's full source, and the command itself is hidden from the palette.
steps: Press Cmd+Shift+P, type "Code: Show Artifacts" and press Return.
If the list says the artifacts belong to your AGI Cloud account, select that item and sign in first.
Make sure a folder is open in VS Code, because the save needs a workspace folder (File > Open Folder).
Select an artifact row, hover it, and click the save icon with the tooltip "Save into the workspace".
In the save dialog, pick a place inside the open folder and click Save, then check the file appears in the Explorer with the artifact's content and compare with Expected.
S33.26.where: Command Palette > Code: Show Artifacts > pick an artifact row > hover it and click the save icon (tooltip: Save into the workspace)
